newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 387,000 MT were off 10 percent from the previous week and 13 percent under the 4-week average.

Major increases were for Spain (88,200 MT, reflects 7,300 new sales, 80,900 destination changes), the Netherlands (56,800 MT, reflects 35,800 new sales, 21,400 destination changes), unknown destinations (54,900 MT), Mexico (52,500 MT), and South Korea (39,900 MT).

Exports of 500,800 MT exceeded the previous week by 2 percent, but were one-fifth less than the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (171,300 MT), Spain (88,200 MT), Japan (72,900 MT), and Mexico (72,100 MT).
